title: Calf Kneading
summary: The calf muscle is gently compressed and released between the palm and fingers.
goal: Work the calf after gentle warming.
startingPosition: The leg is relaxed and supported.
direction: Along the muscular calf from lower to upper areas.
warning: Do not massage with acute pain, recent injury, marked swelling, or inflammation. One-sided swelling, redness, warmth, or calf pain should be medically assessed before massage.
